Subject: Aurora Healthtech POC: success criteria & plan

Hi Sophie / Mateo —

Great to meet you both today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before kickoff: 

Call summary
- Objective: 2-week POC to validate Redwood Inference for near-real-time clinical note generation and EHR integration.
- Primary constraints: PHI handling, on-prem routing via VPC peering, and <2s median token generation latency for 512-token requests.

Success criteria (as discussed) — please confirm these are accurate:
1) Latency: median response < 2s for standard note templates (512 tokens).
2) Throughput: sustain 40 concurrent sessions during simulated peak with <5% error rate.
3) Quality: clinicians rate generated notes >= 4.2/5 on rubric (accuracy, relevance, hallucination).
4) Compliance: data handling passes Aurora compliance checklist and SOC2 questionnaire.
5) Integration: HL7/CCDA ingest and output validated in staging (one-way sync).

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MSA/SLAs & NDA + scope doc.
- Week 1 (11/09 kickoff): infrastructure setup (VPC peering + test creds), seed data upload (de-identified sample), baseline run.
- Week 2 (11/16 - 11/20): focused clinical workflows + metrics collection, QA session with clinicians.
- Wrap-up (11/23): deliverables: evaluation report, perf numbers, recommended config for production.

Ownership (initial)
- Redwood: Grace (project lead), Aditya (infrastructure/engineer on-call), Stephanie (success manager).
- Aurora: Sophie (product lead), Mateo (platform/infra), engineering contact TBD.

Attachments: Aurora-POC-brief-20261101.pdf (detailed runbook and checklist).

Requests / next steps
- Please confirm the success criteria above or call out adjustments by EOD 11/03.
- Provide the primary engineering contact for VPC/IP allowlist and an estimated week when your procurement team can review a short SOW.
- If compliance needs any additional evidence, flag it so we can prioritize.

I'll pencil in a 11/09 10:00 AM PT kickoff in the meantime — will finalize once we have your engineer names.

Thanks,
Grace
